roles.title: Junior Business Analyst - GIS
roles.description: Owns a cross-functional modernization workstream for a mission-critical gas-electric incident notification system, from requirements through validation and delivery.
highlights: Own the modernization workstream for a mission-critical gas-electric incident notification system.
Facilitate workshops with GIS, control-center, support, architecture and engineering leaders to synthesize requirements and map current and future states.
Translate analysis into executive-ready BRD/FRD, process/data-flow, reporting, UAT, migration and rollout recommendations.
Build consensus on 200-ft/24-hour proximity logic, centralized architecture, monitoring/security and implementation sequencing.

roles.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
roles.description: Owns strategic analytics workstreams and delivers recommendations used by Operations, Product, Finance, Sales, Support and leadership.
highlights: Own analytics across Voice of Patient, PC Performance, AI Disposition, Salesforce transfer reporting, communication hold/release and Twilio/Calabrio reconciliation.
Run deep dives, forecasts, variance, funnel, A/B and pre-post analyses and scenario modeling with SQL and Python.
Define KPIs, analyze performance drivers and risks, and deliver recommendations across Operations, Product, Finance, Sales and Support.
Reconcile conflicting data, automate recurring decision tools, and influence roadmap priorities through executive narratives, QA/UAT and training.

roles.title: Technical Intern, Continuous Improvement
roles.description: Solved an ambiguous fleet-planning problem with a custom forecasting tool and led continuous-improvement workstreams across operations.
highlights: Built Fleet Forecaster with React, Flask, PostgreSQL, SQL, Python and Excel/VBA to model fleet demand, capacity, cost and budget scenarios.
Reduced processing from 6 hours to 5 minutes and generated approximately $120K in annualized savings.
Led continuous-improvement workstreams from discovery through implementation, automating workflows with Power Apps, Power Automate, Python and APIs.
Used AI prototypes to reduce manual work and accelerate execution while tracking risks and dependencies.

roles.title: Data Analyst | Business Intelligence & Financial Analytics
roles.description: Led client-facing analytics and strategy engagements and managed BI and data workstreams from requirements through adoption.
highlights: Turned analysis into executive recommendations that generated $200K+ in client value.
Built performance and financial models covering growth drivers, profitability, ROI, forecasting and scenarios.
Integrated Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite, APIs and cloud data, and automated analytics with SQL, Python, dbt and Airflow.
Created reusable dashboards, playbooks and decision frameworks.

roles.title: Business Intelligence Analyst | Data & Systems Analytics
roles.description: Partnered with clients to diagnose business and operational issues and owned several delivery workstreams at once.
highlights: Standardized reusable processes that reduced onboarding time by 30%.
Presented recommendations on customer, product, conversion, retention, churn, sales, marketing and financial performance.
Translated ambiguous requests into scoped requirements, user stories, process/data flows, tests and implementation plans.
Used advanced SQL, Python and BI tools to investigate root causes and supported UAT and training.
